newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Anglo Australian speeds Tasmania gold work.
newsitem.headline: Anglo Australian speeds Tasmania gold work.

text.p: Anglo Australian Resources NL said on Thursday it will accelerate gold exploration in the Denison Goldfield in northeastern Tasmania following promising results in a region unexplored for 60 years.

Enthusiasm for the old field, which was last worked in the 1930s, comes after follow-up trenching of gold soil anomalies produced gold values averaging over 2.54 grams a tonne over 24 metres at the East Denison project, the company said.
Anglo Australian said it controls about 670 square km in the Denison and Gladstone fields.
